items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: So I didn't get a chance to know him (inaudible). But he was very glad to have me come over, I know that.

ctx.x: Yeah. He just had a recording, I don't know what it's like. What about Lester Young? You knew him somewhat, didn't you?
Yeah, I played opposite him in Philadelphia, so I got to hear him a whole lot.
He seemed to be a very sensitive --
